entities.summary: Olumide Larry Ogunjobi is an American professional football defensive tackle. He played college football for the Charlotte 49ers, and was selected by the Cleveland Browns in the third round of the 2017 NFL draft. He has previously played for the Cincinnati Bengals, the Pittsburgh Steelers, and the Buffalo Bills.
